newsitem.title: USA: Carolco files plan of reorganization.
newsitem.headline: Carolco files plan of reorganization.

text.p: Carolco Pictures Inc. said Monday it filed a joint plan of reorganization under Chapter 11 of the bankruptcy code.
The plan was filed jointly with certain units and the committee of creditors holding unsecured claims of Carolco.
Carolco and its units filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy petitions in November 1995 and have since sold many assets.
In January, Carolco announced the sale of its film library, which featured hits such as "Basic Instinct" and "Total Recall" to an affiliate of French pay television firm Canal Plus for $58 million.
Until the reorgnization plan takes effect, Carolco will continue to sell assets in accordance with the bankruptcy court procedures.
The proposed plan provides for creation of a trust to liquidate Carolco's remaining assets. The trust will also prosecute claims and make distributions to creditors.
Under the plan, all equity securities of Carolco, will be cancelled and holders of such securities will not be entitled to receive any distributions.
